ModMetaData.name: 1.7 Compatibility Fixes
ModMetaData.author: EvilEyeGuy
ModMetaData.description:
Fixes for 1.6 mods that break under RimWorld 1.7. The original mods stay untouched.
Project RimFactory: the storage gizmo patch left an extra value on the stack. Harmony under 1.7 rejects that, which stopped all later RimFactory patches. Giant imperial turret: the projectile offset patch could not find its spot and failed to load. GrimWorld 40,000 Framework: the armor mask shader has no Vulkan variant in the 1.6 bundle. The fix takes it from the mod's own 1.5 Linux bundle. Holograms and Projectors: the projectors get the style comp and the name rules that Ideology expects. World generation: a faction ideoligion that ends up without a structure meme gets one instead of breaking world generation. The log names the faction. Items named during world generation, before the player faction exists, no longer log a faction relation error.
